sections.title: How it works
sections.body:
A practical task: export an existing drawing as a shareable link, supplying elements, editor state, and files.

If the backend returns an identifier and file saving succeeds, export returns a URL to pass along.

In excalidraw-app/data/index.ts, export serializes the drawing and compresses it with a generated encryption key.

It collects only initialized images with matching file entries; file encoding must complete before the payload POST.

Import fetches by identifier. Only an OK response proceeds to decoding with the supplied key; non-OK returns an empty object.

Successful decoding and JSON parsing return elements and editor state, each potentially null—not a guaranteed rendered drawing.

New-format decoding or parsing failure attempts legacy decoding; the outer catch alerts and returns an empty object.
